entries.topic: Other Israeli officials' (and US officials') statements on Iran's nuclear timeline and on striking Iran, 1992-2025

claims.text: 1992: Foreign Minister Shimon Peres told French TV Iran was set to have nuclear warheads by 1999; 'Iran is the greatest threat and greatest problem in the Middle East' because it 'seeks the nuclear option while holding a highly dangerous stance of extreme religious militancy'

18 Oct 2007: President Peres's office statement compared the moment to Stalin and Hitler: 'We are nearing a similar turn of events with Ahmadinejad'; 'The world must open its eyes before it is too late'

17 Aug 2012 Channel 2: Peres: 'We can delay the Iranian nuclear plan, but it is clear to us that we need to go with the United States'; Erdan called it 'an unabashed and explicit attack on the official policy of the government'
Sept 2009 (Yedioth): Defence Minister Barak: 'I am not among those who believe Iran is an existential issue for Israel'

CSM/AFP 30 Dec 2010: per WikiLeaks cables, in June 2009 Barak estimated a 6-to-18-month window to stop Iran getting nuclear weapons; Mossad at the same meeting estimated technological capability by 2010-2011

29 Dec 2010 public radio: Strategic Affairs Minister Ya'alon: Iran 'does not have the ability to create nuclear weapons by itself at the moment'; likely 'in the next three years, if it is successful'; difficulties 'have postponed the timetable'

Aug 2010: US officials said they had convinced Israel Iran was at least a year from a bomb; Gary Samore (NSC) told NYT Iran's problems gave it at least a year of 'dash' time; Israel had reportedly believed Iran could have a weapon by the following March

18 Feb 2012 Tokyo: Barak urged tighter sanctions 'before the Iranians fully enter this immunity zone' (point at which programme is invulnerable to attack); Panetta: 'Israel indicated they're considering this, we've indicated our concerns'

Apr 2012 Haaretz interview: Chief of staff Gantz: 'the Iranian leadership is composed of very rational people'; Khamenei: 'I don't think he will want to go the extra mile'; Barak: Iranian leaders not 'rational in the Western sense'; Gantz's aide: words 'taken out of context'

4 Aug 2021: Defence Minister Gantz told UNSC ambassadors Iran was 'only around 10 weeks away from acquiring weapons-grade materials necessary for a nuclear weapon'; 'It is time for diplomatic, economic and even military deeds'
27 Sep 2021 UNGA: Bennett: 'Iran's nuclear weapon program is at a critical point. All red lines have been crossed'; 'Words do not stop centrifuges from spinning'
22 Sep 2022 UNGA: Lapid: 'The only way to prevent Iran from getting a nuclear weapon is to put a credible military threat on the table'

13 Jun 2025: Israeli military said intelligence 'in recent months' showed Iran 'approaching the point of no return'; spokesman Defrin said Iran was 'rushing toward a nuclear bomb' and cited a secret weapons-component programme
8 Sep 2016 Channel 2: Hillary Clinton said Iran had been 'weeks away from breakout' before the deal and the deal 'has made Israel safer'
17 Dec 2011 (60 Minutes, aired later): Panetta said if Iran's leaders decided to go at full speed they could have a weapon in about a year, sooner with a covert facility; 'That's a red line for us'

entries.topic: Israeli and US dissent from the warnings and from a strike on Iran; the US intelligence record

claims.text: AP 7 Jan 2011 citing Yedioth: departing Mossad chief Dagan, in closed conversations, assessed Iran would not have a nuclear weapon before 2015, crediting unspecified 'measures'

6 May 2011 Hebrew University lecture: Dagan called a strike on Iran's nuclear facilities 'a dumb idea that has no benefits' (translation); Barak: 'I am not sure... that his remark, as reported in the media, is correct'; Iran's FM spokesman Mehmanparast mocked Israeli officials

CSM June 2011: Dagan called an Israeli strike 'the stupidest thing I have ever heard'; said it would violate international law; predicted 'war with Iran... we know how it starts, but not how it will end'; strike 'will give the Iranians the best excuse to pursue the nuclear race'
60 Minutes Mar 2012: Dagan: 'The regime in Iran is a very rational one'; 'An attack on Iran before you are exploring all other approaches is not the right way'
27 Dec 2011 to ambassadors (Haaretz): Mossad director Pardo: 'Does Iran pose a threat to Israel? Absolutely'; 'The term existential threat is used too freely'

27 Apr 2012 public meeting: ex-Shin Bet chief Diskin: 'I don't have faith in the current leadership of Israel to lead us to an event of this magnitude, of war with Iran'; decisions 'based on Messianic feelings'; strike could bring 'a dramatic acceleration of the Iran program'; Netanyahu and Barak spokesmen declined comment

Uvda (Channel 2) Nov 2012: in 2010 Netanyahu and Barak ordered Ashkenazi and Dagan to put Israel on 'P Plus' pre-attack status; Ashkenazi warned it might trigger war; Dagan (via associates) said it would be illegal without cabinet approval; Barak said Ashkenazi told him capability 'didn't exist', no final decision taken; Ashkenazi denied, said the army was ready but the mission a strategic mistake

Uvda 31 May 2018: Pardo said Netanyahu in 2011 ordered him to start a countdown for a strike, not 'for the sake of a drill'; he checked with legal advisers; no immediate comment from Netanyahu's office
July 2015: ex-Shin Bet head Ami Ayalon: 'when it comes to Iran's nuclear capability, this [deal] is the best option'; ex-Mossad head Efraim Halevy: 'In the Middle East, a decade is eternity'

23 Nov 2021: ex-MI chief Amos Yadlin: 'The Iranian issue was privatized to one person'; 'The mistake is not in 2015, but in 2018'; Amidror disagreed, called withdrawal 'correct, smart, and appropriate'

2011 NIE update reportedly completed Feb 2011; Clapper: 'We continue to assess Iran is keeping open the option to develop nuclear weapons'; 'We do not know... if Iran will eventually decide to build nuclear weapons'

2 Dec 2011 Saban Center: Panetta: strike 'At best it might postpone it maybe one, possibly two years'; 'Of greater concern to me are the unintended consequences'; possible retaliation on US ships and bases
8 Jan 2012 Face the Nation: Panetta said Iran was laying groundwork for weapons someday but not yet building one; keep pressure so 'they do not make the decision'
4 Mar 2012 AIPAC: Obama: 'Already, there is too much loose talk of war'; 'now is not the time for bluster'

30 Aug 2012 London: Gen. Dempsey: Israeli strike would 'clearly delay but probably not destroy Iran's nuclear program'; 'I don't want to be complicit if they choose to do it'; Ya'alon said such comments led Iran to believe it faced no real risk
4 Oct 2012 Norfolk: Gates: strike 'could... prove catastrophic, haunting us for generations'; would 'make a nuclear-armed Iran inevitable. They would just bury the program deeper'

20 Jun 2025: Trump on Gabbard's March testimony: 'She's wrong'; Gabbard on X: testimony taken out of context; Iran could produce a weapon 'within weeks to months, if they decide to finalize the assembly'

18 Mar 2026 threats hearing: Gabbard declined to say whether IC assessed an imminent nuclear threat: 'the only person who can determine what is and is not an imminent threat is the president'; Ratcliffe: Iran unable to enrich to 60% since strikes; Joe Kent (NCTC) resigned 17 Mar 2026 saying Iran posed no imminent threat
